metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels in Hong Kong decrease during February 10-25, 2020 compared to January 1-20, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-5P NRTI NO2 dataset - Two periods: Jan 1-20, 2020 vs Feb 10-25, 2020 - Location: Hong Kong (approximate coordinates: 22.3N, 114.2E) 2. Masking strategy: - Use quality flag qa_value >= 0.75 for reliable measurements - This is about NO2 levels, not clouds, so we filter for quality 3. Logic: - Valid Zero: NO2 levels can be legitimately low (near 0) - this is a valid measurement - Null/Error (C3): If calculations return None/NaN or values outside reasonable range (NO2 should be positive) - C1: If no images exist in either period - C2: If images exist but no valid pixels after quality filtering - Answer A if Feb mean < Jan mean (decrease) - Answer B if Feb mean >= Jan mean (no decrease) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Hong Kong geometry const hongKong = ee.Geometry.Point([114.1694, 22.3193]).buffer(30000); // 30km buffer // 2. Load Sentinel-5P NO2 data const s5p = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2'); // 3. Get data for both periods const jan = s5p .filterDate('2020-01-01', '2020-01-21') .filterBounds(hongKong) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); const feb = s5p .filterDate('2020-02-10', '2020-02-26') .filterBounds(hongKong) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); const janSize = jan.size().getInfo(); const febSize = feb.size().getInfo(); console.log(`January images: ${janSize}`); console.log(`February images: ${febSize}`); if (janSize === 0 || febSize === 0) { console.log('Missing data for one or both periods.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Calculate means with quality filtering const janMean = jan.mean(); const febMean = feb.mean(); // 5. Reduce to get statistics const janStats = janMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: hongKong, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const febStats = febMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: hongKong, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const janValue = janStats.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean; const janCount = janStats.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count; const febValue = febStats.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean; const febCount = febStats.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count; console.log(`Jan pixels: ${janCount}, Mean NO2: ${janValue}`); console.log(`Feb pixels: ${febCount}, Mean NO2: ${febValue}`); // 6. Validate results if (janCount === 0 || febCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (janValue === null || febValue === null || isNaN(janValue) || isNaN(febValue) || janValue < 0 || febValue < 0) { console.log('Invalid calculation results.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 7. Compare and answer console.log(`Change: ${((febValue - janValue) / janValue * 100).toFixed(2)}%`); if (febValue < janValue) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
